issues.description: The Person model's firstName field is declared public in the solution but is private in the template and the UML/specification. This visibility mismatch is a structural inconsistency that may confuse students comparing template, UML and solution code (it suggests direct field access whereas the rest of the code and the intended design use encapsulation via getters/setters).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the firstName field private in the solution's Person class (and access it via the provided getter/setter) so it matches the template and the UML/specification. Alternatively, if public access was intended, update the template and UML/specification to reflect the public visibility consistently.
